proposal.summary: An improper certificate validation vulnerability in FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiOS, and FortiSandbox products may allow a network-adjacent unauthenticated attacker to man-in-the-middle communications with some external peers.
proposal.affected_product: FortiManager 7.0.1 and below, 6.4.6 and below; FortiAnalyzer 7.0.2 and below, 6.4.7 and below; FortiOS 6.2.x and 6.0.x; FortiSandbox 4.0.x, 3.2.x and 3.1.x

AV.quote: may allow a network adjacent and unauthenticated attacker to man-in-the-middle the communication between the listed products and some external peers.

PR.quote: may allow a network adjacent and unauthenticated attacker

C.quote: may allow a network adjacent and unauthenticated attacker to man-in-the-middle the communication between the listed products and some external peers.

I.quote: may allow a network adjacent and unauthenticated attacker to man-in-the-middle the communication between the listed products and some external peers.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request or review technical details (protocols affected, certificate validation behavior, exploitability) and vendor advisories or patches; obtain reproduction steps to confirm impact and produce a CVSS vector.

evidence_quotes.quote: An improper certificate validation vulnerability [CWE-295] in FortiManager 7.0.1 and below, 6.4.6 and below; FortiAnalyzer 7.0.2 and below, 6.4.7 and below; FortiOS 6.2.x and 6.0.x; FortiSandbox 4.0.x, 3.2.x and 3.1.x may allow a network adjacent and unauthenticated attacker to man-in-the-middle the communication between the listed products and some external peers.
